title: Itihaas
desc: Police officer Joginder Singh and his family's lives are put at risk when the kingpin of the underworld, Alexander, is arrested. When he gets out of prison, he vows to take revenge on those who put him there.

title: Insaf Ka Tarazu
desc: Ramesh, a multi-millionaire, falls madly in love with Bharti. In the turnout of events, Bharti kills Ramesh. Watch the heart wrenching drama to know what compels her to take this dire step.

title: Waqt Ki Deewar
desc: A cruel and lustful man brutally rapes a woman, forcing her to commit suicide, leaving her young children homeless. The children try to stay together but are separated. Years later, one of them has taken to a life of crime with a friend, who, unbeknownst to him, is none other than his mother's rapist.

title: Bhrashtachar
desc: Journalist Bhavani intends to expose and bring to justice a corrupt politician who pretends to be a social worker; however, she soon finds herself trapped in a web of conspiracies.
